notes.title: *GamePad* in the next "WTF platformer" update
notes.content:
The second level for the game is almost ready, and I'm happy to tell you about an additional innovation. In addition to a new unique level, a bunch of memes, new sounds, references, etc. GamePad controls will be integrated into the game.

Good luck to everyone and enjoy the game from the developer and Mr.R :)
